sources.note: Keyless profile: needs nothing that is not in a clean checkout. CPMM and CLMM are the hook-support forks pinned in upstream.lock.toml, built with their `localnet` feature (upstream program ids, admin baked in from tests/fixtures/localnet/admin.json at build time). Hook program ids are the public keys of the throwaway keypairs in tests/fixtures/localnet. The CPMM pool-creation fee receiver is upstream's mainnet address, injected as an empty wrapped-SOL account at genesis. Build with `cargo xtask localnet build`; run with `cargo xtask localnet e2e` (a real solana-test-validator) or the in-process tests.
